params._about: Skyglass charts (engine/charts.ts) tuned values on top of overrides/hunts.params.json. Keys are live AI ids. commons = the common-chart crew copies (scaled to the player: statsMultiplier `stats`, per id pools/rows); rares = rare-chart stat copies chart-r-*; taintedCopies = tainted pair-fight copies chart-t-*; stats.<Replicant Zero> = its solo edit; echo = Lingering Echo hazard; ember = Burning Deck; steep = Steeping Horror; tainted = tainted twists. Schema floor (insertAiSchema): statsMultiplier >= 1 and poolsMultiplier >= 1; the commons soften through innate rows instead (taken: +damage-taken % rows; givenDown: -damage-given %).
params._final_pass: fable/skyglass-final-sim: the Fall's fire source is the Arsenal Keeper himself (RUL-2026-10-29-057 item 5; no separate hazard): a copy of the live Keeper, immobile, pools 4, fought in the powder-magazine fight; Fall press-on Captain copy 2/2 -> 2/0 + 15% givenDown (0/14 after the two-phase rebuild); Burning Heading: Core Horror tainted copy pools 5.5 / 2 rows, afterburn 4 -> 7 rounds (target 55%). Final pass (resumed): Arsenal Keeper 30% innate damage reduction (tanky; Fall 95% -> 75% at 20 seeds, dr 20/25 gave 90%). Burning Heading Core Horror tainted copy 5.5 / 2 rows -> 5.5 / 3 rows + 60% givenDown (20 seeds: 2 rows 100%, pools 6 0%: the F1 duel is a deterministic race at 2 rows; 3 rows + 60% gave 60%; at 40 seeds 60% -> 35%, 70% -> 72.5%, 80% -> 100%; adopted 65%).
params._rul060: RUL-2026-10-30-060 item 2 applied on top of the d5957e79 final pass: the Sealed Reliquary's Sealwright copy (rares) 1 -> 2 damage rows, pools 1 unchanged.
